title: NVIDIA opens a 100M-parameter model for real-time speaker tracking
friendlyTitle: NVIDIA’s open model can tell who spoke in a conversation
summary: NVIDIA’s open-weight Nemotron 3 Diarization model identifies who spoke when across live or recorded conversations, including overlapping speech and up to eight speakers. NVIDIA reports a 14.72% diarization error rate on VoiceArena’s benchmark and provides configurable latency for streaming use.
friendlySummary: Nemotron 3 Diarization can label up to eight speakers in live or recorded audio, even when people talk over each other.
whyItMatters: Reliable speaker labels make meeting notes, call summaries, podcast transcripts and voice-agent memory substantially more useful. Because the weights are open, teams can test the model on their own accents, rooms and privacy requirements before deployment.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can improve meeting notes and call transcripts. Teams can download the model and test how well it works with their own audio before using it.
